# diffusedalice.com

> > A curated collection exploring internet culture, viral memes, and digital trends across platforms like TikTok, Know Your Meme, and social media.

This site aggregates and analyzes contemporary internet phenomena, from exploitable memes and TikTok trends to viral videos and social media movements. It serves as a reference for understanding the evolution and context of digital culture.

## Key Topics

- Know Your Meme
- TikTok
- Viral memes
- Internet culture
- Exploitable memes
- TikTok trends
- Social media
- Meme documentation
- Digital anthropology
- Meta platforms
- Viral videos
- Image macros
- Breaking Bad memes
- DeviantArt

- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide on Nasra Ahmed ICE detention viral meme from Minneapolis incident

## Viral Memes & Trends

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme with Walter White & Jesse Pinkman
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring heartbreaking cat image from DeviantArt
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song catchphrase
